message.content: Based on the conversations recorded, LiHua believes that Lionel Messi's excellence lies in his ability to create chances out of nothing and his vision on the field. Additionally, she emphasizes his incredible work ethic and humility, which she finds inspiring to watch. LiHua also mentions that Messi's impact extends beyond his individual performances, noting that he sets a high standard for future generations of players due to his dedication and consistency.
